what_changed: CFPB defines larger participants in a market for general-use digital consumer payment applications (12 CFR 1090), bringing them under CFPB supervision.
rationale: Supervision of nonbank payment apps, not lenders, servicers or collectors, and not examination of an AI vendor. Kept by the prefilter on 12 CFR 1090. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
